source_snapshot.criteria: Tool PASS and corrected OS event within undefined timeout.

source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires bounded state lifecycle, emergency clear and post-clear negative evidence.

old_problem: Persistent fault state had no documented consuming workload, maximum count/rate/duration, threshold margin, authoritative stop/clear operation or proof that injection ceased.
disposition_reason: Persistent injection cannot be made safe by parameterizing only a tuple. Its vendor arm/status/clear lifecycle and emergency stop are core command/recovery semantics; without them, the injector may cross thresholds or contaminate later tests. ED-16 forbids arming a persistent source before the stop path is proven. Pending/BLOCKED therefore remains until AMD supplies a bounded state machine.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 50, AI fields, historical record 2452 and next pending row 51.
Preserved persistent CE and all-slot coverage distinct from one-shot and UCE modes.
Required maximum event rate/count/time below approved thresholds.
Made post-clear negative access and stable counters mandatory.
No arming, trigger, clear or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD bounded persistent correctable DRAM injection per slot
test_case.purpose: For each mapped slot, prove persistent CE generation only within an approved bounded window and complete cessation after the vendor clear operation.
required_package: Synthetic trigger plus maximum count/rate/duration and threshold margin
Repeated CE location/counter oracle and post-clear negative test
Abort, residual-state recovery and BIOS/HDT restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not arm mode1. Once the lifecycle is approved, select one mapped slot, capture status/counters, arm persistent CE, run the bounded synthetic accesses while enforcing limits, issue the documented clear, repeat a safe verification access proving no new event, confirm inactive status and restore state.
test_case.expected_result: Only the intended slot emits the bounded repeated CE pattern during the approved window; after clear, counters remain stable on the negative access and memory/platform health is normal.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS exists without a proven clear path. Tool PASS, unbounded logs, missing rate/count evidence, continued events after clear or uncertain inactive state cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated ECC SUT with prevalidated OOB and emergency clear.
Never arm without explicit stop syntax and hard exposure limits.
Abort on wrong slot, threshold approach, storm, UCE, reset, poison or failed clear.
No automatic retry; clear first and verify residual state.
expected_evidence: Versioned persistent lifecycle and slot map
Repeated CE count/rate at the target
Clear result, negative access, stable counters, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: The vendor must define emergency stop and residual-state cleanup if normal clear fails. Without a proven recovery that prevents fault leakage into later cases, persistent mode remains blocked.

source_conflict.reason: Persistent activation, trigger, exposure limits, stop/clear and residual-state verification remain missing.

blocked.reason: A persistent fault source cannot be safely armed without authoritative stop and emergency recovery semantics.
